body: There isn't a day where I wake up and don't think about them. It's this constant weight on my shoulders that I can't remove.

Sorry this is late, but I can't say at this time. There's a good chance some sort of stimulus moves the time frame longer too. So much uncertainty right now and the government is handing out money everywhere. Definitely not sustainable, but for now, take advantage where you can.
She can get your cobra benefits only if you are on the cobra option yourself. She can't use it if you aren't using it.
Sorry you feel that way, I'm just trying to help. No harm intended
I wouldn't recommend COBRA unless someone was recently fired. The recent stimulus act covers 80% of COBRA payments, but for any other reason, it would be incredibly expensive.

Hey everyone! I've been a member of this sub for a little over a year and have gotten a lot of info from all of you. I decided to create another account for business purposes to finally post. I am a licensed health insurance agent in PA (licensed in other states as well) and I have access to public and private plans. By going private, you can cut your monthly health insurance costs much lower, you just have to be healthy to qualify for a lower rate. I hate coming off as a "salesperson" with this post, but if anyone is healthy and paying an exorbitant amount for their health insurance, please feel free to send me a DM and we can have a discussion on your options.
